verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs show requests created inside collections, folder-level environments (which imply folder organization), and a Collection Runner that sends multiple requests in order with unlimited collection runs. Saved requests can be rerun without re-entering data, which a community comment also notes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating and nesting folders (only implied via folder environments), independent hands-on corroboration of collection/folder organization.

support.subject: As a developer, I can organize API requests into collections and folders and rerun them anytime

citations.quote: You can create one by clicking the + button on the left panel of a collection and selecting gRPC Request.

Collection environments, which can be accessed by all requests in a collection
* Folder environments
Use the Collection Runner to send multiple requests in a specific order
Automatically test multiple requests in your collections, with unlimited collection runs.
having the ability to call frequently used API requests without having to re-enter JSON data will be very useful.
